utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, before we count you in, can you help Saturday morning, and what tools or repair skills can we actually rely on from you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning should work for me, Mina—count me for the railing first and the hose bib after. You can rely on me for basic wrench-and-pliers work, and I’ll bring screws too if I find that wandering toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—what time Saturday can you be there, and if the toolbox turns up, does it have a drill, bits, and exterior screws?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Hana — I’m still hearing the time and meeting spot aren’t firm yet, so I wouldn’t count on 3:30 to 5. The needs I’ve heard most are leaky gutters and broken porch steps, with Sam handling tables and tool bins.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — I’ll treat 3:30 to 5 as unconfirmed, and I’ll note gutters, porch steps, and Sam on tables/tool bins until Rey and Pia confirm the final list and place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds right, Hana — I’ll keep checking for a confirmed time and spot, and I’ll pass along anything solid as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the building office to confirm the final time and accepted items, so please don’t circulate 3:30 to 5 yet. I’ll tell you as soon as I have the notice in hand.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it, thanks Pia—I won’t share 3:30 to 5 or any item list until you’ve got the official notice. Please confirm the time, place, and accepted repairs when it’s in hand.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Kira—I’ll hold off on announcing anything until the office confirms the notice, including the room, final time, and exact repairs they’ll accept.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Dane, I’m keeping the repair drive list by confirmed locations—do you have any items coming from your place, or a pickup/drop-off spot I should mark down?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, I don’t have any items from my place to list yet, but you can mark me for sign-in late morning. I’m still waiting on the exact time and repair list, and I’ll pass them along once confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—I’ll note you as late-morning sign-in only, with the exact time and repair list still unconfirmed. Just send them over when they’re set, and I won’t add any item locations for you yet.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’m still waiting on confirmed repair drive details for Sunday at the community center, and I’m trying to fit any help around school pickup. If the main window is after the kids are settled, I should be able to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Faye—I’m in the same boat, waiting for a firm time and the posted repair list before I commit. If Nell and Marisol confirm that Sunday community center window, I’ll plan from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Eli—that’s exactly where I am too. I’ll wait for Nell and Marisol’s confirmed window before I promise anything, and I’ll keep school pickup in mind.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, we’re still waiting on Nell and Marisol to confirm the time and place, but I’m lining up helpers now—do you or anyone in your circle want to take on sorting, hauling, sign-in, or repairs?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Count me in for tables, tool bins, and extension cords Saturday morning, and I can help with sorting once setup is done. Dane mentioned he can cover sign-in late morning, so I’ll nudge a couple handy folks about repairs too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Sam—tables, tool bins, cords, and sorting will help a ton, and I’ll pencil Dane in for late-morning sign-in unless he tells me otherwise. Thanks for nudging the repair folks; once Nell and Marisol lock the time and place, I’ll tie everyone together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m still waiting on Pia or the office too, Noah, so I’ll keep it tentative: likely leaky gutters and porch steps, but no firm time or place yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn—that’s what I’ll stick with too: just tentative gutters and porch steps, and no firm time or place until Pia or the office confirms.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Noah—thanks for keeping it careful. I’ll let you know right away if Pia or the office sends the confirmed details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I’m still good for the first hour Saturday—I’ll bring a couple extension cords too, then check with you before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Bo — that’s perfect. Please be at check-in by 9 if that time holds, and I’ll confirm as soon as kickoff is firm.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—I’ll aim for 9 at check-in with the cords, and just ping me if the kickoff shifts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Cleo, thanks for keeping the list tight—once I hear back from Gus and Faye, I’ll send you any tool offers and confirmed helpers for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa—I’ll leave Gus and Faye as pending for now and add any confirmed tools or helpers as soon as you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo—keep them pending for now, and I’ll circle back as soon as I get firm answers so your list stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, I’m still waiting on the firm kickoff time for the repair drive, so don’t treat 3:30 to 5 as certain yet. Sam does have the tables, tool bins, and extension cords covered, at least.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—I won’t treat 3:30 to 5 as firm yet, and I’ll note that Sam has tables, tool bins, and extension cords covered. Send me the kickoff time when it’s settled so I can match volunteers without overpromising.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Mara—once Pia or the office confirms the kickoff, I’ll send it straight to you so the volunteer matching stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli, I’m still waiting on the firm time, place, and accepted repair list for the drive—Nell’s checking with Marisol, and I’ll pass it along once it’s definite.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik—once Nell hears back from Marisol, I’ll keep things loose on my end and not promise folks anything beyond small appliances and simple leaky fixtures for now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds wise, Uli—I’ll tell folks you’re keeping it tentative for small appliances and simple leaky fixtures until Nell and Marisol confirm the full details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Ira, I’m quietly collecting concrete repair notes before evening—do you know of any urgent fixes or spare tools like screws, pliers, a wrench, or plumber’s tape I should pass to Mara and Cleo?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can bring basic hand tools Saturday morning—pliers, a wrench, and a few screwdrivers—but I’m short on plumber’s tape. I haven’t heard confirmed urgent fixes yet, so I’ll keep asking and send you only definite notes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I’ll mark you down for pliers, a wrench, and screwdrivers Saturday morning, and note that plumber’s tape is still needed. Definite repair notes only is perfect; just send anything confirmed my way before evening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Ira, I’m still waiting on a firm kickoff time for the repair drive, so don’t spread any specific hours yet. Sam’s got tables, tool bins, and extension cords covered, though.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Tess—I’ll hold off on sharing any hours and just tell folks Sam has tables, tool bins, and cords covered. I’ll keep listening for the confirmed kickoff time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Ira—once Pia or the office confirms the kickoff time, I’ll pass it along so we’re all saying the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m keeping it simple for now, Opal—tables by the laundry room Saturday morning, and I’m waiting to see the latest signup sheet before I promise anyone a job.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Uli — I’ll mark the laundry-room tables for Saturday morning as confirmed, and I won’t assign any jobs until your signup sheet is updated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Opal. That helps me breathe a little—once Hana or Rosa confirms the sheet, I’ll pass along only what’s truly needed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m checking who can still help—are you available, and is there anything you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa—that helps, but I still need the exact time and the posted repair list before I can commit; once those are set, I’ll say plainly what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Eli—I’m firming up the time and repair list now, and I’ll send both around as soon as they’re posted so you can decide what works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Mara — I’ve only got second-hand bits so far, so I’m trying not to overstate anything. Are the leaky gutters and porch steps still the main focus, and is there any confirmed time or meeting spot yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Nell, you’re right to keep it tentative—leaky gutters and porch steps are still on the likely list, with Oren’s railing also mentioned, but I’m waiting on Rey’s list tonight before I call anything final. No confirmed meeting spot yet, and the only timing I’ve got is Noah likely helping Saturday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep telling folks it’s tentative: likely gutters, porch steps, maybe Oren’s railing, with Noah possibly Saturday afternoon, but no firm time or meeting spot until Rey’s list comes in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Dane—I’ll swing by Saturday with the labeled broken stuff, spare tools, and extension cords, then cover check-in for the first hour.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks, Bo—I’ll take over sign-in after that first hour, and if hauling still needs a hand late morning I’ll point you toward Leo before you head out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Dane—just flag me fast if Leo needs that hauling help, otherwise I’ll zip out after check-in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Quinn, I’m trying not to mix this up—I've got railing first and the leaky hose bib second, but I still need Tess or Leo to confirm whether 3:30 to 5 is really the repair window.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That matches what I’ve heard, Oren—railing first, hose bib second, and I’ll keep telling folks the 3:30 to 5 window is unconfirmed until Tess or Leo confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn—that helps my scattered brain. I’ll hold off telling Faye it’s definite and just say Tess or Leo still need to confirm the 3:30 to 5 window.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Gus, I’ve got the repair drive listed for Sunday at the community center, with the railing first and the garden hose bib next. If you’ve got exterior screws, a wrench set, pliers, or plumber’s tape, I’ll mark them under your name.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You can put me down for the wrench set, pliers, plumber’s tape, and a box of exterior screws, Cleo—I’ll bring my toolbox Sunday to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Gus—I'll mark you down for the wrench set, pliers, plumber’s tape, and exterior screws, and note that you’re bringing the toolbox Sunday to the community center.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rey, I’m lined up to help Saturday morning with tables, tool bins, and extension cords, but I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off time and the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — I’ll note you for Saturday morning with tables, tool bins, and extension cords, and I’ll pass along that you’re waiting on the drop-off time and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rey — once you hear the time and repair list, just send it my way and I’ll make sure I’m there ready to set up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I heard the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, which should be easier around school pickup; I’m still checking what supplies parents can bring before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. I haven’t got confirmation on Sunday or the community center yet, so hold off promising supplies until I get the firm word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—I’ll hold off on telling parents anything firm and just keep a tentative list until you confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana, I’m still waiting for Nell and Marisol to confirm the time and place, and Kira asked me to check whether Pia or the office has posted the accepted repair items before we spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik—that matches what I’m hearing, so let’s hold off on spreading the word until Nell and Marisol confirm the time and place and we know whether Pia or the office has posted the accepted repair list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Exactly, I’ll keep it quiet for now and circle back once Nell or Marisol confirms the meeting details and Pia or the office posts the accepted items.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Kira, I haven’t seen the actual posted sheet yet, so I’m not going to pass along any time or item list until Pia or the office confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, that’s exactly what I wanted to hear—please let me know once you’ve actually seen Pia’s or the office’s confirmation.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do—I’ll hold off on repeating anything, and if I see the actual confirmation first I’ll check the time and accepted items with you before I say a word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, before we rope anyone else in, do we have the location and start time confirmed for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not confirmed yet—Nell is checking with Marisol on the exact time and place, and I’ll tell you as soon as I hear back so we’re not guessing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules—please send the time and place the minute you hear back, and until then I’ll hold off promising volunteers anything firm.
